title: Edge Detection with OpenCV — Hands-On Basics
description: A bundled demo course that showcases the Code widget alongside paired Image widgets (input photo + output edge map) using a simple Python + OpenCV edge-detection pipeline. Two lessons: Sobel gradients and Canny edge detection.

modules.title: Edges, gradients, and the Canny pipeline
modules.summary: Two paired-image lessons that progress from raw image gradients (Sobel) to a complete edge detector (Canny).

lessons.title: Sobel — image gradients in two lines of OpenCV
Canny — turning gradients into clean edges
